body:
### Question

Hi! Is there a way to configure `uv` to make `fork-strategy=fewest` to always resolve to just one version of the package or fail otherwise? That would help to ensure the maximum reproducibility across the covered Python versions. If I understood correctly, `fewest` doesn't guarantee this by default.

As a workaround I was using this to check for packages appearing multiple times `grep "^name =" uv.lock | sort | uniq -d` and `grep "^name =" uv.lock | sort | uniq -d | (! grep .)` when checking if `uv.lock` is up to date, along with `uv lock --check`.

If it's not possible, could this please be relabeled as a feature request.


### Version

uv 0.13.7
title: Strict `fork-strategy=fewest` - resolve to a single version for each package
